author: Forbes
description: As AI drives unprecedented demand for electricity, nuclear startup Aalo Atomics is rethinking how reactors are built. The company is developing factory-manufactured reactors designed to deploy faster and scale more efficiently than traditional nuclear plants. Co-founder Yasir Arafat explains how speed in one of the world’s most regulated industries comes down to mastering the fundamentals, working with regulators, and iterating relentlessly. “80% of the value is in 20% of the effort.”
title: The Founder’s Playbook For Building In Highly Regulated Industries
